name: Welcoming a visitor
context: A visitor has just arrived. Keep the greeting friendly and simple.
text: Hello, welcome! I am glad you could make it today.

name: Explaining a delivery delay
context: An order is late. Acknowledge the inconvenience calmly.
text: I am sorry about the delay. Let me check the latest delivery update for you.

name: Sharing good news
context: A missing item has been found. Sound relieved rather than theatrical.
text: We found it! Your bag is at the front desk, and you can pick it up now.
